column1: # REGISTRY_S4_PRE_R2_v2.tsv -- P05-S4 R2 pre-registration of the three-column run.  Written BEFORE any R2 matrix run.
# This is the registry of record for R2.  It replaces REGISTRY_S4_PRE_R2_DRAFT_INVALID.tsv (kept for audit; ERRATA_2 section 5).
# (A first write under the name REGISTRY_S4_PRE_R2.tsv was refused by the file-version guard and is not used.)
# Scope: injection points whose route (NTH, size) is recorded in the historical registry REG_3C2_FFTCHAIN.tsv and in
#     fft mode           : s4malloc NTH 1 (FFT work, 6144 B), NTH 2 (FFT discval, 16 B)            -> AL01, AL02
#     jones / nv / vl    : s4malloc NTH 3 (ivalues 192 B), NTH 4 (work), NTH 5 (vfield 1024 B)       -> AL03-AL11
#     fft mode           : fft_plan_dft_2d call 1 (real malloc failure inside the plan)              -> P01
#     fft mode           : fft_plan_exec calls 1 and 2 (BOUNDARY SIMULATION, see L-EXEC)             -> EX01, EX02
#   Each injection row is run on the three trees B (tree label BASE), A (CUR) and F (F).  Control row C0 (no injection)
# Deferred to R3, NOT in this file, NOT run: all other FMM S4_malloc sites (kottke, closed, experimental, the cache-hit
#   routes S4FMM_TWICE=slab NTH 7, S4.cpp 2295/2408/2425); fft_alloc_complex (kottke:78, needs kottke_alloc);
#   solve_info SI01-SI02 (needs the linearsolve family, not in the plain library); FE01-FE10 (fmmret, not built on F);
#   the info=NULL seven sites (U2 seam, not built); CLM1-4, ACF1, EXP40; further plan and exec call indices.
# Columns (10, matrix_r2 format): case family tree request NTH stack mode NG expected_class basis
#   tree: BASE = tree B (37a82e8), CUR = tree A (876181c), F = frozen tree F (1c11905).
#   family: S4 = s4malloc route, PLAN = plan route, EXEC = exec route, C = control.
# Judge: testing/d003/judge_d003.py classify() from rc, rc1, rc2, hit.  The driver PASS/FAIL line is never read.
# Limit L-PLAN: fft_plan_dft_2d call index; the injection fails a malloc inside the plan (real allocation).
# Limit L-EXEC: mode exec is a BOUNDARY SIMULATION (the wrapper returns 1 and does not run the plan).  Judge label
#   "(boundary simulation)".  Not evidence of a real execution failure.
# Expectations: from the tree source (line read with git show in R2) and the judge rule.  Status of every row: INFLUENCED
#   (S2R3, S2R5, S2R6, S3R, S3R2 and the R1 registry were read before this file).  No row is a blind prediction.
#   B: the check is absent, so CRASH (dereference) or SILENT_SWALLOW (return discarded).
#   A and F: the check (b00b630, or de52142 at the caller) is present, so REPORTED_FAILURE.
#   The A and F expectations rest on b00b630, which is present in both A and F.
